annotations.title: Base wallet balances and account nonce snapshot: see a Base wallet's ETH and token balances and its transaction count

description: Base only (all 5 chains: wallet_balances; USD values: wallet_portfolio). An address on Base: ETH and major token balances (USDC, WETH, cbBTC, DAI, USDbC, cbETH, AERO, EURC) plus up to 20 token addresses you pass, the account nonce, and whether it is an EOA, a contract or an EIP-7702 account. The nonce counts outgoing transactions only; not transfer or trading history. Use to check a counterparty's holdings. Example: address=0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006. Price $0.005/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

address.description: Wallet or contract address on Base (0x...)

tokens.description: Optional comma-separated extra ERC-20 addresses to check (max 20)
